capabilities: Run six built-in AI actions on the active note or current selection
Chat with follow-up questions after each quick action
Write AI results back via replace selection, append to note, or overwrite file
Switch between Anthropic, OpenAI, Minimax, and Kimi providers with a user-supplied API key
Customize assistant behavior with an optional system prompt
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README is bilingual (English and Chinese) and documents privacy behavior: API key stored locally, no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant, so users must copy note text into external AI tools and paste results back by hand.

relations.evidence: AI assistant for your notes — inspired by Notion AI

requires.name: Anthropic, OpenAI, Minimax, or Kimi API key

summary: AI sidebar panel that runs quick actions (summarize, translate, analyze, extract tasks, continue, polish) on the active note and writes results back to the file.
